name: saaraansh
description: Saaraansh (FactIndic): project-level commands. Run them from this folder.

scripts.dev: npm run db && concurrently --kill-others --names backend,frontend --prefix-colors magenta,cyan "npm run backend" "npm run frontend"
scripts.backend: cd backend && cross-env HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1 .venv\Scripts\python -m uvicorn main:app --port 8000
scripts.setup: npm run setup:backend && npm run setup:frontend && npm run setup:models
scripts.setup:backend: cd backend && python -m venv .venv && .venv\Scripts\pip install torch --index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cpu && .venv\Scripts\pip install -r requirements.txt
